text:
Anya K: quick sync — planning to toggle feature flag `routing.failover_exceptions_v1` to allow non-sticky failover for a small canary of customers (alpha-tenant tag). Need thumbs before I schedule during the 02:00-04:00 UTC low traffic window tonight. Proposed canary: 5% of sessions, only new sessions, TTL 24h stickiness exception.
Samir P: sgtm on window. what are guardrails?
Anya K: guardrails: auto-rollback if 5xx rate increases >0.8% absolute or p99 latency up +200ms over baseline; abort if error budget > 1% in 10m. Also exclude Dedicated accounts and EU region until we validate. I'm adding the rollout config:

```
flag: routing.failover_exceptions_v1
scope:
  - audience: tag:alpha-tenant
  - percent: 5
rules:
  - new_sessions_only: true
  - sticky_override_ttl: 24h
  - exclude_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
rollback_conditions:
  - metric: http_5xx_rate
    delta_threshold: 0.008
    window: 10m
  - metric: p99_latency_ms
    delta_threshold: 200
    window: 10m
```

Omid R: small nit — use 3% instead? 5% may be ok but prefer ramp 1 -> 3 -> 5 over 30m increments. Also add a quick traffic split metric: keep routing.debug=true for canary to trace keys.
Jess H: agree with ramp. also add sticky-session test case: ensure session affinity persists when primary region is healthy and that fallback kicks only on simulated failover.
Anya K: noted. I'll update to staged ramp: 1% for 15m, 3% for 20m, 5% for 30m. Also adding tracing flag `routing.debug=true` for canary. Can someone take on runbook monitoring during the window and handle rollback if triggers?
oncall-bot: Reminder: page oncall@redwood if auto-rollback triggers or if manual rollback needed. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/multi-region-failover
Samir P: I can be oncall for the window. Will subscribe to the alerts and keep the ticket open.
Anya K: thanks — I sent a rollout ticket to #incidents and added TODOs. tagging @Samir P for code review ping on the feature flag PR.
Samir P: reviewing now. quick question in PR about telemetry names; will comment.
Jess H: I'll add a smoke test script. basic check:
```
curl -H "X-Tenant: alpha-123" https://api.redwood/v1/generate | jq .region
# expect primary region unless we simulate outage
```
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: flag-service change 7c9a2 -> routing.failover_exceptions_v1 set to staged. ETA: 6m
Anya K: perfect. when deploy completes, Samir — can you flip the first 1%? then we'll verify traces/alerts for 20m and proceed.
Samir P: yup, will flip at +10m post-deploy. Will post status updates here. :thumbsup:
Jess H: I'll run smoke tests after each ramp and paste results. will create a quick gist for traces.
Anya K: thanks team. leaving notes for follow-up: add dedicated account exclusion to infra docs, update console toggle name to 'Failover exceptions (canary)'.
Samir P: update — PR comment left. minor naming tweak suggested. will apply.
Anya K: last check — anyone object to proceeding tonight?
Omid R: no objections.
Jess H: no objections.
Samir P: no objections.
Anya K: awesome. scheduling now. will post final rollout timeline when deploy bot confirms.
